## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF, with mixed breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +27.32%) and SPY/TLT falling (1W: -2.46% | 1M: -10.10%) confirm defensive pressure; HYG/LQD is also falling (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -2.03%), signaling rising credit stress.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear is increasing: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +27.32%). Credit stress is rising as HYG/LQD falls (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -2.03%), while stocks lag bonds as SPY/TLT falls (1W: -2.46% | 1M: -10.10%).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Tightening bias: Dollar-strength indicator rising (1W: +0.59% | 1M: +0.38%), ABOVE TREND; TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +5.20%) as SPY falls BELOW TREND (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -4.99%). Yield-curve indicator is rising (1W: +0.02% | 1M: +4.50%), ABOVE TREND.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Rotation from Tech to Cyclicals: XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +5.40%) and XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +5.25%), while XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%). XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +7.98%) also shows defensive strength; with breadth at 6/11, style leadership remains mixed.

5. US vs Global?
US weakness: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -4.99%); Europe is in CORRECTION with VGK (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +2.20%). China shows relative strength with FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +4.48%), while EEM is BELOW TREND (1W: -2.80% | 1M: -10.24%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation is weak: ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -13.86%) and IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -7.31%). IWM is also BELOW TREND (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -1.41%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Gold is recovering: GLD (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -1.61%) is in RECOVERY. Industrial metals remain weak, with CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -4.54%) and copper/gold falling (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -3.52%).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy is weak: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -12.00% | 1M: -5.55%) and BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -12.84% | 1M: -2.23%). UNG is in RECOVERY (1W: +2.97% | 1M: -13.51%), a short-term bounce against a weak monthly trend.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Risk pressure across VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +27.32%) and SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -4.99%); TLT is ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +5.20%). DIVERGENCE: XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +5.40%) versus XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%); rotation is pronounced, while sector breadth remains mixed at 6/11.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor a measured defensive tilt: XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +7.98%) and TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +5.20%) show relative strength. Reduce exposure to XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%); avoid treating XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +5.40%) as broad market confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If breadth improves beyond 6/11 and cyclicals hold up, monitor XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +5.40%).
BEARISH: If Tech weakness persists, monitor XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%) for continued downside pressure.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If gold’s recovery holds, monitor GLD (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -1.61%), in RECOVERY.
BEARISH: If industrial demand concerns persist, monitor CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -4.54%).

13. Key Levels?
Monitor SPY/TLT at 8.9757, falling (1W: -2.46% | 1M: -10.10%), BELOW TREND; HYG/LQD at 0.7388, falling (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -2.03%), BELOW TREND. Also watch Tech/Financials at 2.8821, falling (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -20.65%), BELOW TREND, and copper/gold at 0.1011, falling (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -3.52%), BELOW TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, with mixed breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Financials and Discretionary show relative strength, while Tech weakness marks rotation away from Growth rather than broad leadership. Monitor rising fear and credit stress alongside the split between stronger cyclicals and defensive assets.
